# WTCAH Universal (Welcome To Craft Attack Habibi)

**WTCAH Universal** is a meticulously crafted **Fabric** modpack designed for the *Craft Attack Habibi* server community, now available for everyone. This pack aims to provide the definitive "Vanilla+" experience for Minecraft 1.21.

We have bridged the gap between extreme technical performance and stunning visual fidelity. Whether you are a technical player building massive Redstone contraptions or an explorer looking for breathtaking landscapes, this pack is optimized for you.

---

## 🚀 Why play WTCAH Universal?

This is not just a random collection of mods. Every mod has been selected to ensure stability, connectivity, and immersion.

### ⚡ Unmatched Performance
Say goodbye to lag spikes. We utilize the modern Fabric ecosystem to deliver the highest possible FPS and server stability.
* **Sodium & Lithium:** The gold standard for rendering and logic optimization. Expect vastly improved framerates compared to vanilla.
* **FerriteCore:** significantly reduces RAM usage, making this pack playable even on modest hardware.
* **Entity Culling & ImmediatelyFast:** Ensures that crowded areas with many mobs or items render smoothly without slowing down your game.

### 🎨 Visual & Audio Overhaul
We have completely reimagined how the game looks and feels without losing its blocky charm.
* **Iris Shaders:** Full shader support out of the box. We have included **Complementary Shaders - Unbound** specifically for this pack to give you beautiful lighting, shadows, and water reflections.
* **Fresh Animations:** Mobs are no longer static statues. Creepers scuttle, Spiders crawl realistically, and Villagers have expressive faces.
* **Visuality & 3D Skin Layers:** Particle effects are enhanced, and player skins have added depth for a more polished look.
* **Sound Physics Remastered:** Experience realistic sound reverberation in caves and muffled audio through walls for true immersion.

### 🛠️ Quality of Life (QoL)
We believe in removing the tedious parts of Minecraft while keeping the gameplay balanced.
* **JourneyMap:** A real-time minimap and world map to keep track of your exploration and waypoints.
* **Jade:** Instantly see what block or entity you are looking at, including harvestability and health.
* **Inventory Management:** Sort your chests and inventory with a single click thanks to **Mouse Tweaks** and sorting mods.
* **Recipe Browser:** Never guess a crafting recipe again. **JEI (Just Enough Items)** is included for instant recipe lookups.

---

## 📋 Full Feature List

* **Multiplayer Ready:** Includes `Simple Voice Chat` (requires server-side installation) and connectivity fixes for a seamless online experience.
* **Dynamic Lights:** Hold a torch in your hand to light up your surroundings without placing it.
* **Camera Utils:** Zoom in to see distant objects or use freecam for screenshots.
* **Animation Fixes:** Includes `Not Enough Animations` and `First-person Model` improvements.

---

## ⚙️ Installation Guide

1.  **Download:** Use the Modrinth App or your preferred launcher to install this modpack.
2.  **RAM:** We recommend allocating at least **4GB of RAM** to Minecraft for the best experience.
3.  **Shaders:** Shaders are included but may need to be enabled in the Video Settings > Shader Packs menu depending on your hardware.
